responsibilities.name: Project Status & Milestone Synchronization
responsibilities.instruction: Synchronize project milestones, current task tracking records, and overall project status documents from Google Workspace (Drive, Docs, Sheets) into the agent's working memory. Identify any slipping deadlines or blocked tasks.

context.purpose: Ensure the agent has the latest and most accurate view of the project's milestones, task status, and dependencies, and proactively flag risks.
process: Scan the project Google Drive folders to identify key status sheets and milestone documents
Read and parse the project tracking Sheets or Docs containing active milestones and task lists
Identify and highlight any milestones that have slipped past their target dates, or tasks marked as blocked/delayed
Compile a concise project health summary detailing milestone progress, active bottlenecks, and immediate priorities, and write it to working memory.
context.success_criteria: A synthesized project status report is compiled and saved to memory, capturing latest milestones, status, and blockers.
context.prior_learnings: When checking milestones, always compare against actual current date. Do not modify source sheets or documents automatically during sync unless correcting formatting errors or explicitly requested.
